## About
New Design Auto Body is a family-owned and operated collision repair shop on 52nd Ave in Hyattsville. We handle collision, framework, detailing and paint, and we treat your vehicle as if it were our own.
Wayne is the owner, and reviewers mention Michael at the service desk and Dianna and Wally by name. What people tell us they notice is the communication: calls and texts about where your car stands, and answers when you have questions.
We're rated 4.7 on Google from 354 reviews. If you've had a fender bender or something bigger, give us a call and we'll walk you through it.

## Services
- Auto Body Repair: Reliable, honest and affordable repair for collision damage, large or small.
- Auto Painting: Paint work to bring your car's finish back after a repair.
- Insurance Work: We work with all insurance companies and can also do non-insurance work.
- Framework: Frame repair as part of getting your car right after a collision.
- Detailing: Detailing to get your car looking its best.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We work with all insurance companies, and we can also do non-insurance work if you'd rather pay directly.

Q: What kinds of cars do you repair?
A: We work with all makes and models.

Q: Can you help me get a rental car?
A: One reviewer said getting a rental vehicle through Enterprise was easy while her Jeep was in the shop. Ask us when you call.

Q: Who will I be dealing with?
A: A service advisor will take care of you. One reviewer named Michael, the service advisor, as helpful, professional and responsive.
